description.zh: 网络通道名称。由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成，字母或数字开头，字母或数字结尾，最长64个字符。
description.en: The name of the network channel. The name must consist of lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start and end with a letter or a digit. The name can be up to 64 characters long.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that ensures the request is idempotent. The client generates this token. The token must be unique for each request. It is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters long.
The name of the source instance.
The ID of the resource group.
The name of the destination instance.
The IP address of the destination instance.
The port of the destination instance.

description.zh: 访问端点所在的专有网络ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the endpoint is located.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb create-network-channel --resource-group-id rg-re000000000 --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --channel-name ch4 --target-db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --target-ip 192.00.00.46 --target-port 9032 --notes test --vpc-id vpc-25cdvfeq58pl0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
